reading.body:
Flexential Charlotte - South in Charlotte, North Carolina, publishes 2.36 MW of IT capacity across 66,666 square feet of technical space, operated by Flexential.

At 10 kW per rack, a common enterprise colocation density, that load supports roughly 236 racks. At 40 kW per rack, a density closer to AI training workloads, it supports roughly 59 racks. The operator has not published a per-rack power envelope, so neither figure is the operator's own claim, only what the published megawattage implies under each assumption.

Flexential Charlotte - South holds 6 published certifications: SOC 1 Type 2 (audited controls over financial reporting processes), SOC 2 Type 2 (audited controls over security, availability, and confidentiality, tested over time rather than at a point), PCI DSS (the standard required to handle payment card data), ISO 27001 (a certified information security management system), HITRUST (a healthcare-focused security framework built on top of HIPAA), SSAE 18 (the attestation standard underlying SOC reports). Together these qualify the facility for regulated workloads spanning security auditing, payments, and healthcare data, though which specific tenants rely on which certification is not disclosed.

North Carolina has 6 facilities mapped in this site's dataset, of which 5 publish a megawatt figure, totaling 51.47 MW. Flexential Charlotte - South contributes 2.36 MW of that total. At that published size it is a small facility relative to what frontier AI training infrastructure requires, which now runs into the tens or hundreds of megawatts, though it may still support inference workloads or smaller-scale AI applications.
